sub_graphs.name: State Data Structures
sub_graphs.description: Core data structures for persistent state (State) and intra-transaction transient storage (TransientStorage). State holds the main account trie, per-account storage tries, snapshots for nested transactions, and a set of created accounts.

invariants.text: State._main_trie is a secured Trie mapping Address to Optional[Account] with default None.
State._storage_tries maps each Address to a secured Trie[Bytes32, U256] only if the account has non-empty storage.
State._snapshots stores nested transaction snapshots as a list of (main_trie_copy, storage_tries_copy) tuples.
TransientStorage._tries maps Address to Trie[Bytes32, U256] for transient data that persists only within a transaction.
TransientStorage._snapshots stores nested snapshots of transient tries for rollback support.

state_variables.name: State._main_trie
state_variables.description: Main account trie, secured, default None.

state_variables.name: State.created_accounts
state_variables.description: Addresses of accounts created in the current transaction.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Lifecycle (Snapshot Management)
sub_graphs.description: Functions for managing nested state transactions via snapshotting. begin_transaction copies current state, commit_transaction discards the snapshot, and rollback_transaction restores from it. All three also manage TransientStorage snapshots.

invariants.text: begin_transaction MUST push a deep copy of the main trie and all storage tries onto State._snapshots.
commit_transaction MUST pop the top snapshot without restoring it.
rollback_transaction MUST restore State._main_trie and State._storage_tries from the popped snapshot.
When _snapshots becomes empty after commit or rollback, created_accounts MUST be cleared.
begin/commit/rollback MUST symmetrically manage TransientStorage._snapshots alongside State._snapshots.
Snapshot operations must maintain stack discipline: every begin must be matched by exactly one commit or rollback.

functions.description: Start a nested state transaction by snapshotting current state and transient storage.
Commit a nested state transaction by discarding the top snapshot.
Rollback a nested state transaction by restoring from the top snapshot.

pre_post_conditions.text: len(State._snapshots) decreases by 1 and state is restored to snapshot values.

sub_graphs.name: Account CRUD Operations
sub_graphs.description: Functions for creating, reading, updating, and deleting accounts in the state trie. Includes get_account (returns EMPTY_ACCOUNT for missing), get_account_optional (returns None for missing), set_account, destroy_account, and destroy_storage.

invariants.text: get_account MUST return EMPTY_ACCOUNT (not None) when the address has no account in the trie.
get_account_optional MUST return None when the address has no account in the trie.
set_account with None deletes the account from the trie but does NOT delete its storage.
destroy_account MUST delete both storage (via destroy_storage) and the account itself (via set_account(None)).
destroy_storage removes the address key from _storage_tries if present.

functions.description: Get account at address, returning EMPTY_ACCOUNT if not found.
Get account at address, returning None if not found.

functions.signature: set_account(state: State, address: Address, account: Optional[Account]) -> None
functions.description: Set or delete account at address.
Remove account and its storage completely.
Remove all storage for an address.

sub_graphs.name: Storage Operations
sub_graphs.description: Functions for reading and writing per-account storage slots, computing storage roots, and accessing original (pre-transaction) storage values for EIP-2200 gas metering.

invariants.text: get_storage returns U256(0) for unset keys or accounts with no storage trie.
set_storage requires the account to exist in the main trie (asserted).
set_storage: when all storage is deleted (trie._data == {}), the address entry MUST be removed from _storage_tries.
storage_root asserts State._snapshots is empty (no active transactions) before computing.
storage_root returns EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT for accounts with no storage trie.
get_storage_original returns U256(0) for accounts in created_accounts (new accounts have no pre-existing storage).
get_storage_original reads from _snapshots[0] (the outermost/initial snapshot), not the current state.

functions.signature: get_storage(state: State, address: Address, key: Bytes32) -> U256
functions.description: Get storage value, returning U256(0) if unset.

functions.signature: set_storage(state: State, address: Address, key: Bytes32, value: U256) -> None
functions.description: Set storage value; cleans up empty tries.
Compute storage root for an account (no active transactions).

functions.signature: get_storage_original(state: State, address: Address, key: Bytes32) -> U256
functions.description: Get original pre-transaction storage value from initial snapshot.

pre_post_conditions.text: Account at address must exist in State._main_trie.
State._snapshots must be non-empty (at least one transaction begun).

sub_graphs.name: Transient Storage Operations
sub_graphs.description: Functions for reading and writing transient storage (EIP-1153), which persists within a transaction but is cleared between transactions.

invariants.text: get_transient_storage returns U256(0) for unset keys or addresses with no transient trie.
set_transient_storage cleans up empty tries: when trie._data == {}, the address is removed from _tries.
Transient storage is managed through TransientStorage snapshots in begin/commit/rollback_transaction.

functions.signature: get_transient_storage(transient_storage: TransientStorage, address: Address, key: Bytes32) -> U256
functions.description: Get transient storage value, returning U256(0) if unset.

functions.signature: set_transient_storage(transient_storage: TransientStorage, address: Address, key: Bytes32, value: U256) -> None
functions.description: Set transient storage value; cleans up empty tries.

sub_graphs.name: Account Query Functions
sub_graphs.description: Boolean query functions for checking account properties: existence, code/nonce presence, storage presence, and liveness (exists and non-empty).

invariants.text: account_exists returns True iff get_account_optional returns non-None.
account_has_code_or_nonce returns True iff nonce != 0 OR code != b''.
account_has_storage returns True iff address is a key in State._storage_tries.
is_account_alive returns True iff account exists AND account != EMPTY_ACCOUNT.

functions.description: Check if account exists in state trie.
Check if account has non-zero nonce or non-empty code.
Check if account has any storage.
Check if account exists and is not EMPTY_ACCOUNT.

sub_graphs.name: High-Level State Mutation Functions
sub_graphs.description: Higher-level functions that modify account properties: modify_state (with empty-account cleanup), move_ether, set_account_balance, increment_nonce, set_code.

invariants.text: modify_state MUST destroy the account if after modification it has nonce==0, code==b'', and balance==0.
move_ether MUST raise AssertionError if sender balance < amount.
move_ether: sender.balance decreases by amount AND recipient.balance increases by amount (conservation of ether).
increment_nonce increases the account nonce by exactly Uint(1).
All mutation functions use modify_state, inheriting its empty-account cleanup behavior.

functions.signature: modify_state(state: State, address: Address, f: Callable[[Account], None]) -> None
functions.description: Apply a mutation function to an account, then destroy if resulting account is empty.

functions.signature: move_ether(state: State, sender_address: Address, recipient_address: Address, amount: U256) -> None
functions.description: Transfer ether between accounts with balance check.

functions.signature: set_account_balance(state: State, address: Address, amount: U256) -> None
functions.description: Set account balance to a specific amount.
Increment account nonce by 1.

functions.signature: set_code(state: State, address: Address, code: Bytes) -> None
functions.description: Set account bytecode.

sub_graphs.name: State Root Computation
sub_graphs.description: Functions for computing the Merkle Patricia Trie root of the entire state and for resource cleanup.

invariants.text: state_root asserts State._snapshots is empty (no active transactions).
state_root computes the trie root with a callback that provides per-account storage_root values.
close_state deletes all state fields, releasing resources.

functions.description: Calculate the Merkle Patricia Trie root of the entire state.
Free resources held by the state.

sub_graphs.name: Account Creation Tracking
sub_graphs.description: Tracks which accounts were created during the current transaction, used by get_storage_original and EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT constraints.

invariants.text: mark_account_created adds the address to State.created_accounts.
The created_accounts marker is NOT removed on transaction rollback (intentional for safety).
created_accounts is cleared when the outermost transaction commits or rolls back (snapshots becomes empty).

functions.description: Mark an account as created in the current transaction for EIP-6780 and storage original tracking.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Gas Constants
sub_graphs.description: Protocol-level gas cost constants governing transaction intrinsic costs, calldata pricing (EIP-7623), contract creation, access lists, and the per-transaction gas limit cap (EIP-7825).

invariants.text: TX_BASE_COST = Uint(21000): minimum gas required for any transaction.
FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST = Uint(10): minimum gas per calldata token under EIP-7623.
STANDARD_CALLDATA_TOKEN_COST = Uint(4): standard gas per calldata token under EIP-7623.
TX_CREATE_COST = Uint(32000): additional gas for contract creation transactions.
TX_ACCESS_LIST_ADDRESS_COST = Uint(2400): gas per address in access list.
TX_ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST = Uint(1900): gas per storage key in access list.
TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT = Uint(16_777_216): maximum gas limit per transaction (EIP-7825).

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Data Structures
sub_graphs.description: Frozen slotted dataclasses representing the five Ethereum transaction types (Legacy, AccessList/EIP-2930, FeeMarket/EIP-1559, Blob/EIP-4844, SetCode/EIP-7702) plus the Access tuple and the Transaction union type.

invariants.text: All transaction dataclasses are frozen (immutable) and slotted.
LegacyTransaction uses gas_price (single price) and v/r/s signature fields.
AccessListTransaction adds chain_id and access_list to legacy, uses y_parity instead of v.
FeeMarketTransaction replaces gas_price with max_priority_fee_per_gas and max_fee_per_gas.
BlobTransaction adds max_fee_per_blob_gas and blob_versioned_hashes; to field is Address only (no contract creation).
SetCodeTransaction adds authorizations tuple; nonce is U64 (not U256); to field is Address only.
Transaction is the union type: LegacyTransaction | AccessListTransaction | FeeMarketTransaction | BlobTransaction | SetCodeTransaction.
Access dataclass pairs an account Address with a tuple of Bytes32 storage slots.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Encoding and Decoding
sub_graphs.description: Functions for encoding transactions to their wire format (RLP or typed-envelope) and decoding back. Legacy transactions are RLP-encoded directly; typed transactions are prefixed with their type byte (0x01-0x04) followed by RLP encoding.

invariants.text: LegacyTransaction is returned as-is (no type prefix) during encoding.
AccessListTransaction is encoded as b'\x01' + rlp.encode(tx).
FeeMarketTransaction is encoded as b'\x02' + rlp.encode(tx).
BlobTransaction is encoded as b'\x03' + rlp.encode(tx).
SetCodeTransaction is encoded as b'\x04' + rlp.encode(tx).
decode_transaction MUST be the inverse of encode_transaction: decode(encode(tx)) == tx for all valid transactions.
decode_transaction raises TransactionTypeError for unknown type bytes (not in {1,2,3,4}).

functions.description: Encode a transaction to RLP or typed envelope format.
Decode a transaction from RLP or typed envelope format.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Validation and Intrinsic Cost
sub_graphs.description: Functions for validating transactions and calculating their intrinsic gas cost. Validation checks gas sufficiency, nonce overflow, init code size limits, and the per-transaction gas limit (EIP-7825). Intrinsic cost includes base cost, calldata cost (with EIP-7623 floor), contract creation cost, access list cost, and authorization cost.

invariants.text: validate_transaction MUST reject if max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor_gas_cost) > tx.gas (InsufficientTransactionGasError).
validate_transaction MUST reject if nonce >= U64.MAX_VALUE (NonceOverflowError per EIP-2681).
validate_transaction MUST reject contract creation (to==Bytes0) if len(data) > MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE (InitCodeTooLargeError).
validate_transaction MUST reject if tx.gas > TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT (TransactionGasLimitExceededError per EIP-7825).
calldata_floor_gas_cost = tokens_in_calldata * FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST + TX_BASE_COST (EIP-7623).
tokens_in_calldata = zero_bytes + (len(data) - zero_bytes) * 4 (each non-zero byte counts as 4 tokens).
data_cost = tokens_in_calldata * STANDARD_CALLDATA_TOKEN_COST.
For contract creation: create_cost = TX_CREATE_COST + init_code_cost(len(data)).
Access list cost = sum(TX_ACCESS_LIST_ADDRESS_COST + len(slots)*TX_ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST) for each access entry.
Authorization cost (SetCodeTransaction only) = PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST * len(authorizations).
intrinsic_gas = TX_BASE_COST + data_cost + create_cost + access_list_cost + auth_cost.
validate_transaction returns (intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor_gas_cost) on success.

functions.description: Validate transaction and return (intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor_gas_cost).
Calculate intrinsic gas cost and EIP-7623 calldata floor cost.

pre_post_conditions.text: tx must be a valid Transaction union member.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Sender Recovery
sub_graphs.description: Recovers the sender address from a transaction's cryptographic signature using ECDSA recovery on secp256k1. Handles all five transaction types with their respective signing hash schemes.

invariants.text: r must satisfy 0 < r < SECP256K1N.
s must satisfy 0 < s <= SECP256K1N // 2 (low-s normalization).
For LegacyTransaction: v=27/28 uses pre-EIP-155 signing hash; v=35+2*chain_id or 36+2*chain_id uses EIP-155 signing hash.
For typed transactions (AccessList, FeeMarket, Blob, SetCode): y_parity must be 0 or 1.
Sender address = last 20 bytes of keccak256(recovered_public_key).
Each transaction type uses its own specific signing hash function.

functions.description: Extract sender address from transaction signature via ECDSA recovery.

pre_post_conditions.text: Returns a valid 20-byte Address derived from the recovered public key.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Signing Hash Functions
sub_graphs.description: Functions that compute the signing hash for each transaction type. Each function serializes the transaction fields (excluding signature) in a type-specific way and applies keccak256.

invariants.text: signing_hash_pre155 hashes RLP(nonce, gas_price, gas, to, value, data) -- no chain_id protection.
signing_hash_155 hashes RLP(nonce, gas_price, gas, to, value, data, chain_id, 0, 0) -- EIP-155 replay protection.
signing_hash_2930 hashes 0x01 || RLP(chain_id, nonce, gas_price, gas, to, value, data, access_list).
signing_hash_1559 hashes 0x02 || RLP(chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas, to, value, data, access_list).
signing_hash_4844 hashes 0x03 || RLP(chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes).
signing_hash_7702 hashes 0x04 || RLP(chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas, to, value, data, access_list, authorizations).
Each signing hash type prefix byte matches the transaction type byte used in encoding.

functions.description: Compute pre-EIP-155 signing hash.
Compute EIP-155 signing hash with chain_id replay protection.
Compute EIP-2930 signing hash.
Compute EIP-1559 signing hash.
Compute EIP-4844 signing hash.
Compute EIP-7702 signing hash.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Hashing
sub_graphs.description: Computes the keccak256 hash of a transaction for use as a unique transaction identifier.

invariants.text: LegacyTransaction is hashed as keccak256(rlp.encode(tx)).
Typed transactions (as Bytes) are hashed as keccak256(tx) where tx includes the type prefix byte.
Input must be either LegacyTransaction or Bytes (asserted).

functions.description: Compute the keccak256 hash of an encoded transaction.
